trap.label: assistir
trap.wrong: The judge asked me to assist the hearing.
trap.right: The judge asked me to attend the hearing.
trap.why: Em português “assistir a” é ver ou estar presente. Em inglês, assist significa ajudar; estar presente é attend.

mcq.q: A rhetorical question that exposes vagueness:
“I would not put a number on it” means...
Who speaks for the other side in court?

fix.right: Opposing counsel objected to the question.

fix.wrong: Reasonably, fairly, quite — all hedges, isn’t it?
fix.right: Reasonably, fairly, quite — all hedges, aren’t they?

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com attend: “He was present at the hearing.”
Reescreva com object to: “Counsel disagreed formally with the question.”
Reescreva como eufemismo: “He lied.” (He was economical with…)
rewrite.answer: He was economical with the truth.
